headline: Bogotá Presents 42.7 Trillion Peso Draft Budget for Fiscal 2027
summary: Bogotá's Finance Secretariat submitted a 42.7 trillion peso budget proposal, prioritizing urban transit mobility with 8.9 trillion pesos (20.9% of spending) alongside education allocations.
why: Bogotá's municipal budget represents the largest municipal public investment expenditure plan in Colombia.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Bogotá's COP 42.7T municipal budget establishes major infrastructure funding for mobility and education.
